key_claims.claim: A co-learning NLP framework mining 38 million PubMed abstracts can systematically identify persistent evidence gaps in maternal and pediatric pharmacotherapy research.
Multimodal AI integrating clinical, imaging, and procedural data predicts long-term mortality after TAVI more accurately than conventional risk scores in multicenter validation.
Bosniak v2019 classification predicts malignancy in approximately 75 percent of class III-IV cystic renal masses, with subclass and nodule size adding prognostic value for unfavorable histology.
The retina-specific foundation model RETFound does not consistently outperform standard pretrained deep-learning models, particularly when full training data are available.
COVID-19 pneumonia survivors show persistent ventilation defects on hyperpolarized Xe-129 MRI and quantitative CT at five years despite near-normal spirometry.
